adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review recovered primary MIC rows from XML Tables 2 and 3, reconciled linked database rows against those source rows, checked DOC supplements for mechanism-only material, and closes the prior generic rework ticket with accepted-with-cautions status.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Source review resolved quantitative DBAASP rows except the M3 V. parahaemolyticus database value conflict; APD6/CAMP/dbAMP broad annotations with omissions or non-quantitative species text are preserved as source_conflict rather than smoothed.

No hemolysis/cytotoxicity row was found in XML, PDF text, OA package, DOC supplements, or linked database snapshots; final activity evidence therefore reports MIC activity without fabricated toxicity endpoints.
MOESM1/MOESM2 DOC files were opened with antiword and contain CD/NMR/high-resolution figure materials; landing .bin assets are HTML landing pages, not spreadsheet activity tables.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded best-effort source recovery checked XML/NXML, PDF text, OA package figures/docs, local supplements, and linked APD6/DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows relevant to the gate.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Primary source Tables 1-3 and merged database rows support most quantitative DBAASP/dbAMP values; remaining mismatches and broad non-quantitative annotations are preserved as source_conflict cautions, not blockers.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Sixty-three target-specific MIC rows were recovered with raw values, units, targets, conditions, and source locators. No toxicity endpoint is recoverable locally, so toxicity is recorded absent rather than inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: SEM supports direct cell-envelope damage for L1 in two tested bacteria; CD/NMR and mutant MIC data support structural context without overclaiming a molecular target.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The prior rwk-complete-test-0001 blockers were checked directly against source paths and are resolved with cautions.

summary: Recovered source tables now support the activity layer and database adjudication; acceptance remains cautious because database annotations contain preserved conflicts and no local source reports toxicity assays.
